SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REGISTRY
B. D. 5422(K)
28 5 41

May 26, 41.

B. S. Barbash, Esq.,
36 Route Paul Henry,
Shanghai.

Sir,

In reply to your letter of May 20, with regard
to the attempts you are making to obtain permission for
Mr. and Mrs. L. Rosin and family and Mr. and Mrs. J.
Shifrin and family, now resident in Palestine, to proceed
to Shanghai, I have to confirm the information given you
verbally by the Shanghai Municipal Police that permits
issued by the Council are only necessary for persons
resident in Europe.

The two application forms enclosed with your
letter are return herewith as requested.

I am, Sir,

Your obedient servant,

〔此处转录不清〕

Deputy Secretary.

随函附上您来信中所附的两份申请表，按您的要求退回。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

REPORT

Special Branch ............Station. File No.................... Date May 22, 1941

SUBJECT: B. S. BARBASH - Applications for Immigration
Certificates - Letter addressed to
the Shanghai Municipal Council.

With reference to the contents of
the attached communication addressed to the
Shanghai Municipal Council, the issue at stake
is clear cut. This office has received instructions
that permits will not be issued for persons
now domiciled in Palestine, since Palestine cannot
be termed part of Europe.

Apart from these remarks were permits
to be issued to the people concerned as mentioned
on the applications, US$400 per adult and US$100
per child (if under thirteen years of age) would
have to be deposited with the Committee in
Shanghai prior to the necessary permits being
issued since cousins do not constitute blood
relations according to the interpretations
placed upon the Immigration regulations by this
office.

J. A. Sicks
D.S.I.

主题：B. S. BARBASH - 申请移民证书 - 致上海公共租界工部局的信函。

关于所附致上海公共租界工部局信函的内容，问题所在十分明确。本处已收到指示，不得向目前定居在巴勒斯坦的人员签发许可证，因为巴勒斯坦不能被称为欧洲的一部分。

除上述意见外，如果按照申请表中所述向相关人员签发许可证，则必须在签发必要许可证之前，向在上海的委员会存入每名成人400美元及每名儿童（十三岁以下）100美元的保证金，因为根据本处对移民条例的解释，表亲不构成血亲关系。

K38/1
POLICE FORCE FOR COMMENT
with a view to be returned after
27 MAY 1941
B. S. BARBASH & CO.
36 Route Paul Henry
Shanghai, May 20, 1941.

The Secretary
The Shanghai Municipal Council
Present

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. 3. B. D. 8422(K)
Date 21 / 5 41

Sir,

I beg to enclose herewith two applications regarding Messrs. Rosin & Family and Jacob Shifrin & family, Palestine-subjects, who want to come to Shanghai. They are old China hands, have left Harbin in 1932 and went to Palestine, where they bought orange plantations. They have brothers in Tientsin who are merchants, and are related to me too. They would like to come again to China and to remain here a certain time.

I have guaranteed to the Immigration Department that I am capable of taking care of all the needs of immigrants referred in those applications, attached herewith, and the Immigration Committee has endorsed by two applications.

Unfortunately Mr. Pitts has refused to issue the permits, saying that Palestinian subjects do not need any permits. Very likely it is so, but, unfortunately, the shipping or airplane companies in those countries think that such permits are necessary and refuse to sell tickets for this reason.

I understand that you can do nothing in this matter, but I beg to request you to issue a clear statement, in which please confirm that no Palestinian subject needs a permit to come to Shanghai, for which statement I thank you in anticipation.

This statement, which I need very urgently, will be sent by me by airmail to my relations, and they will be able to prove to the transportation companies in Palestine or en route that they are to be given passage-tickets and that no hinderances shall be put on this account on their way.

I also beg to request you to be so good enough and to return me the above mentioned two applications after perusal.

Please give this matter your usual attention, and oblige,

Yours obedient servant,

(Sgd) B.S. Barbash & Co.

5 encl.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别处登记处
编号 3. B. D. 8422(K)
日期 41年5月21日

先生：

谨此附上两份申请书，涉及 Rosin 先生一家及 Jacob Shifrin 先生一家，均为巴勒斯坦籍人士，希望前来上海。他们是老中国通，曾于1932年离开哈尔滨前往巴勒斯坦，并在那里购买了柑橘种植园。他们在天津有经商的兄弟，也与本人有亲属关系。他们希望再次来到中国，并在此停留一段时间。

本人已向移民局保证，有能力照顾所附申请书中提到的所有移民的需求，且移民委员会已在两份申请书上背书认可。

不幸的是，Pitts 先生拒绝签发许可证，称巴勒斯坦籍人士不需要任何许可证。情况很可能确实如此，但不幸的是，这些国家的轮船或航空公司认为此类许可证是必要的，并因此拒绝出售船票或机票。

本人理解贵方在此事上无能为力，但恳请贵方发布一份明确声明，确认巴勒斯坦籍人士前来上海无需许可证，对此声明本人预先致谢。

这份本人急需的声明，将由本人通过航空邮件寄给我的亲戚，以便他们能够向巴勒斯坦或途中的运输公司证明，他们应获得船票或机票，且不会因此受到阻碍。

本人亦恳请贵方惠予审阅后，将上述两份申请书退还本人。

请对此事给予惯常关注，不胜感激，

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）B.S. Barbash & Co.
